description: This file defines an React context provider component 'AuthProvider' that manages user authentication state using Supabase. It includes functions to initialize session state, listen for auth changes, refresh session, and sign out. The file also provides a hook 'useAuth' for accessing auth state throughout the React app.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides auth state and actions via context.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context.
